text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide has asked me to<n>review race
footage together, so after<n>returning to the school I
head over to<n>meet her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... My positioning is a little<n>sloppy. I have a bad
habit of just<n>staring straight ahead during races.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's watch again from the beginning.<n>I'm sure
we'll find other issues too.

Since she's just finished her first<n>race and concert
performance, I figure<n>she must be pretty tired.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You needn't worry about me. Now<n>that I've
experienced a real race, I'm<n>discovering a lot of
issues I never<n>noticed before.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And we need to fix them. The winning<n>equation I so
desire to complete is the<n>very thing I'll be using
against her,<n>after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: (Right... The winning equation against Narita Brian.)

text_block_list.text:
It seems she's realized how<n>exceedingly difficult it
will be to<n>perfect her equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Acceleration... wind resistance... the<n>angle at which
my feet hit the<n>ground...

Maybe my role as her trainer should<n>be to provide
practical experience that<n>will allow her to develop
her<n>calculations.
choice_data_list: Do you want to enter the Asahi Hai F.S.?
Do you want to enter the Asahi Hai F.S.?

text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes is a G1<n>race between
the top junior racers.

The competition is fierce, but it might<n>be a good
experience for her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And a good one, at that. I'll do it.

Her glasses glint in the light as we<n>lock in our next
course of action.
